# archify's schemas, for tests

`architecture`, `erd`, `class` and `common.schema.json` are copied unchanged
from [archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) at commit
`a4065941f12be7967436261d9934784e381d423c` (`archify/schemas/`), under the
Apache License 2.0 (Copyright 2026 tt-a1i, 2025 Cocoon AI). The tests of
`src/core/archify/` check the JSON archrift writes against them. Copy them
again when archify's `schema_version` changes.
